description: Return the Moon's phase and illuminated percentage at a time (default now), the next full and new Moon, and what it means for observing faint objects. Use it for Moon questions; for an overall observing score use observation_conditions. Computed locally (Meeus), within about 0.5 hour of JPL ephemerides; no network call.

lang.description: Language of the text fields: fr (default) or en.

time.description: Moment to compute, ISO-8601 (default now). Years 1900-2200.

name: moon

outputSchema.description: Returns time_utc, phase (phase_fr, phase_en), illumination_pct, waxing, elongation_deg, next_full_moon_utc, next_new_moon_utc, observing advice.

title: Moon phase
